about_text: Plastmak builds machines for aluminum and vinyl (PVC) window and door fabrication in Bursa, Turkey. Its roots go back to Anadolu Makina, a family business founded in 1968; the company has built window and door machinery as Plastmak since 2007 and exports about 80 % of its production to more than 60 countries. The range covers every step of a window shop: upcut, double-head, glazing bead and miter saws for aluminum extrusions and vinyl profiles; single-, double- and 4-corner vinyl welders and CNC corner cleaners; a 9-axis profile machining and cutting centre, 3-axis CNC drilling and milling machines, copy routers and end mills; a hydraulic corner crimper for aluminum, screwing and sash assembly machines, portable machines and conveyors; and complete production groups for 40 to 220 windows a shift.

NovoTech sells, installs and supports Plastmak machines in Canada from Mississauga, ON — the machines chosen for your profiles and your output, a CSA-approved panel, operator training, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support in Canada.
